title: Tactic
description: A repeatable pattern by which a manufacturer claim diverges from reality across products. Tactics are the unit of theoretical interest.

regulatory_basis.description: Existing regulation, statute, or precedent relevant to the tactic, with citation.

consumer_harm.description: How this tactic damages buyer decision quality or safety.

tactic_family.description: High-level family this tactic belongs to (e.g. 'regulated_metric_misapplied')
